newsitem.title: USA: Varlen sees difficult Q1 comparison.
newsitem.headline: Varlen sees difficult Q1 comparison.

text.p: Varlen Corp said Monday it expects difficult first-quarter comparisons but steadily strengthening quarterly performance as the year progresses.

"We expect the first quarter to be a difficult comparison," said president Richard Wellek, citing two elements present a year ago that do not apply now: large truck builds were particularly strong in the 1996 first quarter and the company still had its non-core laboratory equipment business.

"We expect an upward quarter to prior-year quarter trend as the year progresses," Wellek added. Despite truck and trailer markets operating at or below 1996 levels, he said the manufacturer of engineered transportation products should benefit from the rampup build rates of recently introduced Freighliner and PACCAR models.
In the third quarter, Varlen expects to begin shipping a major new product -- its patented Mechanical Diode one-way clutch for automatic transmissions to Ford Motor Co.
Earlier, Varlen reported primary earnings for the January 31 fourth quarter of $0.50 per share, down from $0.54 the prior year.

"It was a tougher year for our truck/trailer operations," Wellek said in a statement. "Large truck builds in North America were down 20 percent and trailer builds off 25 percent, although still at historically high levels. While lower throughput reduced productivity at our facilities, we had a very respectable year as we continued to perform better than the industry."
